jobs.job_title: Frontend Angular Developer – Al Qassim, Unaizah, Saudi Arabia
jobs.job_description:
Location: Al Qassim - Unaizah, Saudi Arabia

Job Category: Information Technology (IT) & Software; Remote / Work-from-Home Opportunities is not applicable.

Job Overview

NTG Clarity is hiring a Frontend Angular Developer to join its team in Unaizah, Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia. This opportunity is suitable for frontend developers with 2-4 years of professional experience and strong hands-on expertise in Angular.

The successful candidate will contribute to building responsive, user-friendly web applications using modern frontend technologies. The role requires proficiency in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, along with experience integrating REST APIs and following frontend development best practices.

Candidates should demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and effective debugging skills. This position is open exclusively to Saudi nationals.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular.

• Build user-friendly interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

• Integrate REST APIs with frontend applications.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve frontend development issues.

• Follow frontend coding standards and development best practices.

• Use Git for version control and collaborative development.

• Support application performance, usability, and maintainability.

Requirements & Qualifications

• 2-4 years of professional experience in frontend development.

• Strong hands-on experience with Angular.

• Good knowledge of TypeScript and JavaScript.

• Proficiency in HTML5 and CSS3.

• Experience developing responsive and user-friendly web applications.

• Practical experience integrating REST APIs.

• Familiarity with Git and frontend development best practices.

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

• Saudi nationality is mandatory.

Salary, Benefits & Career Growth

The employer has not specified salary, compensation, or employee benefits for this position.

This role offers an opportunity to apply and strengthen frontend development skills through practical work with Angular and related web technologies. Further professional development, training, certification support, and career progression details should be confirmed with the employer.
